g.text: a) Zip tie Electromagnet & sensor cable to the cable chain holder
b) Pay attention not to route the electromagnet cable over the sensor
c) Cut the excessive length of the zip ties
a) 用扎带将电磁铁和传感器电缆固定到电缆链支架上
b) 注意不要让电磁铁电缆绕过传感器
c) 剪掉扎带多余的长度

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'4',"0246_M3x12 socket countersunk head screw Black")
ShowToolTip(evt,'5',"0260_M4x16 socket thin head cap screw Black")
ShowToolTip(evt,'6',"0265_M3x6 Socket head cap screw Black")
ShowToolTip(evt,'21',"0241_M3x10 socket head cap screw Black")
